external.description: Enable external access from outside the cluster.

externalIPs.description: Reserved addresses for the endpoints `external: true` publishes. Each entry pins one endpoint to an address held by an IPAddressClaim, so the address survives a rebuild of this VM. Empty lets the load balancer assign any free address, as before.

claim.description: Name of an IPAddressClaim in this namespace whose address the endpoint should wear. Until the claim binds, the endpoint keeps whatever address the load balancer assigned.

hostname.description: DNS name the tenant's external-dns application publishes the pinned address under, as the `external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/hostname` annotation of the pinned Service. Several names may be joined by commas. Needs an external-dns application in this namespace whose domain filters cover the name; without one the annotation is inert.

target.description: Which external endpoint to pin. `default` is the VM's own Service, the endpoint `external: true` publishes, and is the default. A VM has one external endpoint, so attaching several addresses to one VM is not expressible here.

externalMethod.description: Method to pass through traffic to the VM.

externalPorts.description: Ports to forward from outside the cluster.

externalAllowICMP.description: Whether to accept ICMP traffic to the VM in PortList mode (preserves ping and PMTU discovery). No effect in WholeIP mode. Default true so ping behaves as users expect even when port filtering is in effect.

runStrategy.description: Requested running state of the VirtualMachineInstance

instanceType.description: Virtual Machine instance type. Ignored when `resources` sizes the VM, which needs whole-number cpu and sockets plus memory; the whole type is dropped then, so any dedicated CPU placement, hugepages, NUMA or realtime settings it carries go with it. While this field is set, a `resources` block that sizes only part of the VM is rejected outright instead of ignored, so complete it or clear it.

networks.description: Networks to attach the VM to.

gpus.description: List of GPUs to attach (NVIDIA driver requires at least 4 GiB RAM).

name.description: The name of the GPU resource to attach.

cpuModel.description: Model specifies the CPU model inside the VMI. List of available models https://github.com/libvirt/libvirt/tree/master/src/cpu_map

firmware.description: Firmware and boot configuration (UEFI/BIOS selection, Secure Boot, persistent EFI NVRAM).

bootloader.description: Bootloader to boot the VM with: "uefi" (OVMF) or "bios" (SeaBIOS). Empty inherits the instanceProfile default.

efiPersistent.description: Persist EFI NVRAM (e.g. enrolled Secure Boot keys, such as an updated Microsoft UEFI CA) across reboots. Only applies when bootloader is "uefi". On default RWO storage the VM is node-pinned (no live-migration).

secureBoot.description: Enable UEFI Secure Boot. Only applies when bootloader is "uefi".

resources.description: Resource configuration for the virtual machine. Set whole-number cpu and sockets together with memory to size the VM directly, which overrides `instanceType`. Alongside an `instanceType`, a block that sizes only part of the VM is rejected; cpu or sockets on its own sizes nothing and is ignored.

sshKeys.description: List of SSH public keys for authentication.

cloudInitSeed.description: Seed string to generate SMBIOS UUID for the VM.
